questions.content: During biology practical lesson, Amina entered the laboratory while eating chocolate and chatting loudly with her friends. She started touching bottles and apparatus without asking the teacher. Another student began running across the room and accidentally dropped a glass beaker on the floor. Identify the laboratory rules should be followed by the students
questions.markIncrementProvenance: Independent self-assessment increments within source part maximum; source per-step weights are not asserted.
questions.answerKey: Do not eat or drink in the laboratory; avoid disruptive chatting and listen to instructions; ask the teacher before touching bottles or apparatus; walk carefully rather than running and report broken glass to the teacher.
questions.markingGuide: Source allocates 8 marks at 2 per rule. Independently corrected rubric: award 2 each for four appropriate rules addressing the incident: never eat/drink in the laboratory; avoid noisy/disruptive chatting and follow instructions; obtain teacher permission before handling bottles/apparatus; walk rather than run and report breakages. Accept valid equivalent safety rules clearly related to the stated events. No teacher permission makes laboratory food/drink safe.
questions.solutionProvenance: Independently prepared and biology/safety-checked SomaSmart correction; source guide field-only or unsafe text is explicitly retained in guideDiscrepancy. Not an official district correction or NECTA scheme.

questions.sourceContent: What would be the Importance of learning biology in your daily life? Explain briefly by giving six (6) points
questions.workedSolution: Introduce biology as the study of living things and briefly name relevant branches (2). Explain six distinct uses: environmental care and conservation; classification that makes organisms easier to study; body functions and personal health; research cooperation; disease prevention/treatment; and agriculture/food production (2 each, 12 total). Conclude by linking biological knowledge to informed daily decisions (1). This elaborates the supplied guide independently.

verificationNotes: All 7 original paper pages and all 3 guide pages inspected visually. Page 7 is blank answer space only; all actual question text is transcribed. Original misspellings and grammatical defects are retained. Superscript zero in the printed temperature notation is represented as Unicode ⁰; original image/PDF retained.
